column1: # Claims of docs/concepts/security.md, converted from its author's claim list.
element
the console runs as root for its whole life, and its unit sets no sandboxing
the parser's bounds, with no input-reachable panic
the parser is fuzzed
the screen is fuzzed
the font helper runs as nobody
the font helper starts with an empty environment in /, in its own process group, holding only its pipes
the console reads the helper's ids back before it trusts it
the console refuses a helper holding another account or group
the font helper refuses to run as root
the font helper's limits: memory, CPU, file size, no children, no core
the font helper's landlock: no writes, no network, no signals
the font helper's seccomp filter refuses sockets
the helper program checks: absolute, regular, owner, mode
the helper program's refusals
the image helper runs as the session's user, or vtium-image before login
the login classes that count as a logged-in user
the pre-login account the package creates
the image helper starts from the program opened and checked once
the image helper's child setup: session, signals, descriptors, limits, ids
a root helper has every capability removed
the image helper's seccomp allow-list
the worker's landlock domain
the image helper decodes PNG, JPEG and GIF
a decode that takes 2 seconds fails
3 crashes a session, then no more image helpers
the file rules: no /proc, /sys or /dev but /dev/shm
the file rules: regular files only
the file rules: the temporary file rule
replies never echo what a program sent; a fixed empty title
OSC 52 sets the selection and is never read back
allow-font-ops, on by default
OSC 50 names only installed frits or built-in fonts
a frit name is a name, never a path
allow-window-ops, off by default
a link is copied, never opened
clipboard-write, on by default, with no system clipboard
vtium.conf is trusted only when root owns it and its directories
the trust check covers every folder above the file, through each link, on descriptors
the console reads vtium.conf through the trust check
an untrusted vtium.conf: the compiled-in configuration and a notice
the login key runs as root
vtium-config installs through sudo, with no path or program option
check-config opens nothing under /dev and writes nothing
open and closed policies
ignored keyboards are watched only for the VT keys
switch-on-enter only under the open policy
the closed policy keeps the getty off: the marker
the getty fallback skips the VT while the marker exists
/bin/login -p with reset-env
reset-env, on by default
seat mode opens vtium's own PAM session
sessions kept in systemd's fd store
only vtium may write to the store
a restart ends no session
the holder's socket, which only root may open
vtium.enable=0 exits before vtium.conf
a shared-memory object is removed by any program in the session
